title: Measuring distance on a grid (distance-transform)
description: Distance Transform computes the nearest seed distance using Euclidean, Manhattan or Chebyshev metrics. Bands make their different unit circles visible.
description_ko: Distance Transform이 유클리드·맨해튼·체비쇼프 방식으로 가장 가까운 씨앗까지의 거리를 계산해요. 띠 무늬로 거리 기준의 차이를 보여요.
prompt: Measuring distance on a grid. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
